decisions.boundary_condition: Treat the pool and exercise facility as the durable core preference and the hot tub as a softer additional preference. Do not infer indoor versus outdoor pool requirements, a specific pool type, or unrelated room amenities unless stated for the current trip.
decisions.condition: When choosing or comparing hotels based on wellness or recreation amenities.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize hotels that offer both a pool and an on-site fitness center, gym, or comparable exercise facility; among otherwise suitable options, prefer one that also has a hot tub.
decisions.exception_condition: Relax the hot-tub preference when it materially limits suitable options, and relax either core amenity when the user explicitly waives it or stronger current-trip constraints favor another hotel.
decisions.name: prefers_hotels_with_pool_fitness_and_optional_hot_tub
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels with both a pool and an on-site fitness facility, with a hot tub as an additional preference when available.
decisions.rationale: These candidates substantially overlap on a durable preference for hotels with both a pool and an exercise facility. The hot-tub evidence is repeated but not universal, so one soft conditional policy preserves it without incorrectly requiring all three amenities for every stay.
